BREAKING — Rolando Roque Rossell was booked into the Webb County Jail on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, on an alleged third-degree felony charge of evading arrest or detention with a vehicle, along with two alleged misdemeanor charges, according to Webb County booking records.

Rossell was booked on three charges, all warrantless and on-view with an offense date of October 20, 2026: (1) EVADING ARREST OR DETENTION WITH A VEHICLE — a third-degree felony under Texas law; (2) RESIST ARREST, SEARCH OR TRANSPORT — a Class A misdemeanor; and (3) DISPLAY OF FICTITIOUS LICENSE PLATE — a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set on any of the charges as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The arresting agency was the Laredo Police Department. No case numbers were listed in the booking record.

A third-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to ten years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000. Webb Watch 956 will follow this case as it moves through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Rolando Roque Rossell is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

*Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Oct. 21, 2026); Webb County public-access court records.*

*— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956*
